fixed_paragraph: When I walk into a room full of people, I immediately start chatting with everyone. When I hear music playing, I can't help but dance along. When I meet someone new, I eagerly ask them questions to get to know them better. When I'm at a party, I love to be the center of attention and make everyone laugh. When I have free time, I prefer to spend it with friends rather than being alone. When I see someone sitting by themselves, I go over and strike up a conversation. When I'm in a group setting, I naturally take the lead and organize activities. When I hear about an event, I enthusiastically invite others to join me. When I experience something exciting, I can't wait to share it with others.
